text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages at substantial gains felt rewarding, but I should avoid letting that satisfaction alone decide when to sell.","My account value moved both down and up while I held, so I should judge each holding by its prospects and risk—not react to a single month's change.","I should keep a diversified portfolio and make deliberate, infrequent decisions rather than let loss aversion or a gain on one stock dominate my choices."]}
